title: Pass it on with std::move
description:
`addName` takes its `name` parameter by value, so it owns its own string. It then **copies** that string into the vector and throws its own copy away. One of those two strings is pointless.

Change one line so the string is **moved** into the vector instead. The tests check that the vector ends up holding the very same character buffer the caller's string had.
hints: A named variable is never moved from automatically, even one you are about to throw away. `std::move(name)` gives permission.
